Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FOUR-PANEL ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT IMAGE for the game Close the Deal, round 5. Make a wide 3:2 image at highest resolution available, ideally 3072x2048. LEFT COLUMN direction A, RIGHT COLUMN direction B. TOP ROW HERO, BOTTOM ROW PLAY. No weapon/HUD overlay. STYLE: clearly STYLIZED IN-GAME SCREENSHOT, clean deliberately simplified geometry and hard designed shadow masses, sharp cel-shaded elongated angular lawyer characters, glossy abstract corporate future imagined in 2001, optimistic product architecture, Gen X Soft Club restraint, architectural Frutiger Aero WITHOUT bubbles. High-gloss paper-white lacquer, polished pale resin floor with soft blurred reflections of light and dark figures, glossy storey-height cobalt blocks, silver inset edges, near-clear glass with ONLY one broad and one thin translucent diagonal sheen per pane. Shiny but simple material response, no photoreal textures, no archviz photo, no realistic lens/DOF. Blue-white-silver-navy palette; cyan only ONE narrow 10 mm route line. Flat clean ceilings with long recessed white coves; capsule cuts, curved negative spaces and sky-lens motifs. No mirror glass, no carpet, no ceiling tile grid, no printers/monitors/filing clutter, no plants, no grime, no pipes/greeble, no neon cyberpunk, no purple/pink/rainbow gradients, no bubbles.

Left hero: glossy concave capsule ceiling cove follows the turn, a tall narrow recessed cobalt capsule niche carries small "L / LEGAL" typography, one inset printed sky-lens high on the wall; a small run of window glass shows actual sky at far side only. Floor cobalt inlay and thin cyan line turn around the corner toward the hub, no endless straight tunnel. Glass partition high frosted strip, clear body. Left play: approach that rounded opaque corner, one clean 1.1 m-high capsule counter in foreground outside the 2 m clear lane; an enemy partly concealed by the solid return and still visible through TWO clear panes on the bypass, bright white backing. Show the side route rejoining behind the island, human scale and short 4-8 m exposure.
B / RIGHT: "Offset planes". The same loop topology abstracted into staggered flat glossy white/cobalt full-height planes and an asymmetrical slot of clear glass, three broad volumes only. Huge flush white "L" in a storey-height COBALT END FIELD; ceiling split into two shallow flat coves, a single thin floor line bends at right angles toward the visible open branch. No capsules, no corridor symmetry, no tall freestanding obelisks cluttering movement. Right hero: looking through staggered corners that reveal 2 m branch then rejoin, long exposed view is interrupted after 8 m. Right play: close low white counter leading into a 90-degree turn, enemy visible through clear slot between opaque walls, body unobscured by bars, near glass sheen is very faint.
